---
title: "Vincent Lomas - A method for including additional socio-demographic factors in social contact matrices for compartment-based epidemic models"
date: 2026-12-02
comments: false
---

On 2nd December at 9am UK time, Vincent Lomas from the University of Canterbury will present some of his work integrating socio-demographic factors into epidemic models.

Infectious disease models typically account for age as a key sociodemographic factor that affects the transmission and burden of disease. However, these models often don't account for other sociodemographic factors, such as ethnicity, that are of key interest to policy decision makers leaving burden estimates of key groups up in the air. Our work aimed to extend age-based social contact matrices to explore how epidemic outcomes change when accounting for additional socio-demographic factors.
